newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call money seen at 4.0-7.0 pct in May-I-Sec.
newsitem.headline: Indian call money seen at 4.0-7.0 pct in May-I-Sec.

text.p: Indian call money should trade in a broad 4.0 percent to 7.0 percent range through May, ICICI Securities and Finance Co (I-Sec) said in a debt market report on Monday.
"The excess of bids amounts over accepted amounts at repo auctions give a fair indication of the quantum of surplus liquidity available at the short end," I-Sec said.
This difference was about 80 billion rupees on Aprl 7, leading to increased buying interest in medium- and long-term securities, I-Sec said.

Although the gap had fallen sharply to around 45 billion rupees by the end of April, it would still be an adequate buffer and prevent call money rates from staying high over a sustained period of time, it said.
Call money was traded in the 9.5-10.5 percent range early on Monday.
